analysis.evidence: The subject is גְּבוּל הַכְּנַעֲנִי, “the boundary of the Canaanites.” The phrases beginning with מִצִּידֹן, “from Sidon,” trace its course. In context, “the boundary ran from Sidon” expresses this spatial use of “was.”
analysis.morphology: The prefixed conjunction וַ precedes יְהִי, the shortened Qal wayyiqtol form, third masculine singular. The verb agrees with גְּבוּל, “boundary.”
analysis.sense: to be in a state or condition

analysis.evidence: גְּבוּל הַכְּנַעֲנִי means “the boundary of the Canaanites.” The verse traces its course from Sidon (מִצִּידֹן), using עַד to mark how far it extends.
analysis.morphology: Masculine singular common noun in the construct state, with הַכְּנַעֲנִי as its complement.

analysis.evidence: גְּבוּל הַכְּנַעֲנִי means “the boundary of the Canaanites.” The description traces that boundary from Sidon, identifying the people whose territory it encloses.
analysis.morphology: The definite article הַ precedes a masculine singular absolute gentilic used collectively.
